An '''adamant sword''' is the [[Adamant equipment|adamant]] [[Weapons#Sword|sword]], made by smithing a [[diamond sword]] with [[adamant alloy]]. At {{Hp|8}} it is the strongest sword, and every hit weakens the target.

== Obtaining ==

=== Smithing ===
{{Recipes}}

The upgrade needs no template, and enchantments on the diamond item carry over; where both have the same enchantment, the higher level is kept.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/function/mechanics/intrinsic_enchants/process_intrinsic_enchants.mcfunction}}</ref>

== Usage ==

=== Combat ===
It deals {{Hp|8}} damage at an attack speed of 1.6, with 3000 durability. The adamant weapon intrinsic inflicts Weakness II for 8 to 12 seconds on every hit. Weakened mobs are what the [[Doom]] intrinsic of adamant armor detonates.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/enchantment/adamant_weapon.json}}</ref>

=== Intrinsics ===
Sharpness I, Unbreaking II and Weakness. Intrinsics are stored on the item and applied as enchantments when it enters a player's inventory.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/function/mechanics/intrinsic_enchants/apply_intrinsic_enchants.mcfunction}}</ref>

=== Repairing ===
It can be repaired in an [[anvil]] with {{MCW|Block of Diamond|blocks of diamond}} or [[adamant scrap]]. The pack resets repair costs to zero, so it can be repaired indefinitely; see [[Repairing]].

=== Smelting ingredient ===
{{Uses}}

In a [[blast furnace]] it melts down into one [[adamant alloy]], returning the alloy but losing the diamonds.

=== Trading ===
An apprentice [[weaponsmith]] buys it for one [[adamant alloy]].<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/villager_trade/weaponsmith/2/netherite_sword.json}}</ref>

== History ==
{{History|
{{History line|1.03|The vanilla netherite recipes were blocked.}}
{{History line|1.10|A [[weaponsmith]] now takes the item back in exchange for its alloy, so players can rebuild it with updated stats.}}
{{History line|1.12.1-alpha|Smithing no longer takes an ingot in the template slot, and the upgrade keeps the base item's enchantments. Added the "Repaired with" tooltip. The real attack speed and damage now match the tooltip. [[Divinity]] was replaced with Sharpness.}}
{{History line|1.12.2|Now inflicts Weakness. Moved to the <code>matcha</code> namespace; older copies can be updated with <code>/trigger update_item</code>.}}
}}
